# wasm-html-to-image

> High-performance WebAssembly HTML-to-image renderer and image optimization engine.
> Consolidates HTML rendering (Satoru / Skia / litehtml) and native image encoding (WebP / AVIF / JPEG) into a single, unified WASM binary.

## Core Capabilities
- **HTML to Image**: Render HTML strings, arrays (multi-page PDF), or remote URLs directly to PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, RAW, ThumbHash, SVG, or vector PDF.
- **Image Optimization & Conversion**: Direct image-to-image resizing, cropping, and format re-encoding (e.g., JPEG to WebP/AVIF, GIF to animated WebP) without HTML layout overhead.
- **Universal Runtime**: Runs seamlessly on Node.js (>=20), Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge Runtime, Browsers, Deno, and CLI.
- **Zero Heavy Dependencies**: NO Puppeteer, Chromium, Playwright, or node-canvas required.

---

## Installation

```bash
npm install wasm-html-to-image
```

---

## Subpaths & Environment Guide

Choose the appropriate import based on runtime and use case:

| Subpath | Target Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `wasm-html-to-image` | Universal (Recommended) | Auto-routes: uses `workerd` on Cloudflare, `single` elsewhere. Direct `render()`. |
| `wasm-html-to-image/single` | Node.js, Bundlers | Self-contained single-bundle WASM entry with instant `render()`. |
| `wasm-html-to-image/workerd` | Cloudflare Workers | Pre-compiled `WebAssembly.Module` compatible with strict Cloudflare isolates. |
| `wasm-html-to-image/edge-light` | Vercel Edge Runtime | Tailored for edge sandbox memory and execution constraints. |
| `wasm-html-to-image/workers` | Node.js, Browsers (on workerd: no pool, falls back to direct execution) | Multi-threaded worker pool for high-throughput batch rendering. |
| `wasm-html-to-image/react` | React (JSX) | Directly render React element trees. |
| `wasm-html-to-image/preact` | Preact (JSX) | Directly render Preact element trees. |
| `wasm-html-to-image/tailwind` | Tailwind CSS | Inlines UnoCSS / Tailwind utility classes into inline CSS styles. |
| `wasm-html-to-image/index` | High-throughput servers | Manual WASM module reuse via `loadHtmlToImageModule()` and `htmlToImage()`. |

---

## Standard Usage Patterns

### 1. Zero-Config HTML Rendering

```typescript
import { render } from "wasm-html-to-image";

const result = await render({
  value: `<div style="padding: 20px; background: #1e293b; color: white; font-family: sans-serif;">
    <h1 style="margin: 0; font-size: 24px;">Hello World</h1>
  </div>`,
  width: 800,
  format: "png", // 'png' | 'jpeg' | 'webp' | 'avif' | 'jxl' | 'svg' | 'pdf' | 'raw' | 'thumbhash'
});

console.log(result.data); // Uint8Array (or string for format: 'svg')
console.log(result.width, result.height); // Output dimensions
```

### 2. Image Optimization & Format Conversion

Pass an image buffer (`Uint8Array` or `Buffer`) or a `data:image/...` URL directly to `render()`. The library automatically detects image magic bytes and skips the HTML layout pass.

```typescript
import fs from "node:fs/promises";
import { render } from "wasm-html-to-image";

const inputBuffer = await fs.readFile("input.jpg");

// Convert & compress JPEG -> WebP
const webp = await render({
  value: inputBuffer,
  width: 600, // Optional resize
  format: "webp",
  quality: 80, // 0-100
});

// Convert -> AVIF with speed control
const avif = await render({
  value: inputBuffer,
  width: 800,
  format: "avif",
  quality: 75,
  speed: 6, // 0 (best quality) - 10 (fastest)
});

// Crop and resize
const cropped = await render({
  value: inputBuffer,
  crop: { x: 50, y: 50, width: 300, height: 300 },
  width: 150,
  height: 150,
  format: "png",
});
```

### 3. Cloudflare Workers (root import recommended)

```typescript
// wrangler.jsonc: no "rules" needed on current Wrangler (v3/v4) —
// `import ... from "*.wasm"` is bundled as WebAssembly.Module by default.
// Minimal wrangler.jsonc: { "main": "src/index.ts", "compatibility_date": "2026-09-01" }
// (Only configure "rules" yourself if you customize bundling rules or use a very old Wrangler.
// Note: @cloudflare/vite-plugin ignores "rules".)

import { render } from "wasm-html-to-image"; // auto-selects the workerd build on Cloudflare ("wasm-html-to-image/workerd" also works)

export default {
  async fetch(request: Request): Promise<Response> {
    const result = await render({
      value: `<h1 style="color: blue;">Edge OGP Image</h1>`,
      width: 1200,
      height: 630,
      format: "png",
    });

    return new Response(result.data, {
      headers: { "Content-Type": "image/png" },
    });
  },
};
```

### 4. Vercel Edge Runtime (`edge-light`: caller-supplied wasm required)

Unlike `workerd`, `edge-light` bundles no default wasm: `render(options, wasm)` requires a pre-compiled `WebAssembly.Module` as the 2nd argument.

```typescript
import { render } from "wasm-html-to-image/edge-light";

const wasm = await WebAssembly.compile(
  await (await fetch(wasmUrl)).arrayBuffer(),
);

const result = await render(
  {
    value: `<h1 style="color: blue;">Edge OGP Image</h1>`,
    width: 1200,
    height: 630,
    format: "png",
  },
  wasm,
);
```

### 5. High-Throughput Worker Pool (`workers`)

```typescript
import { render } from "wasm-html-to-image/workers";

const tasks = items.map((item) =>
  render({
    value: `<h1>${item.title}</h1>`,
    width: 600,
    height: 400,
    format: "webp",
  }),
);

const images = await Promise.all(tasks);
```

### 6. High-Throughput Server Module Reuse (`index`)

```typescript
import { loadHtmlToImageModule, htmlToImage } from "wasm-html-to-image/index";

// Load WASM module once at server boot
const mod = await loadHtmlToImageModule();

// Reuse in request handlers
app.get("/ogp", async (req, res) => {
  const result = await htmlToImage(mod, {
    value: `<h1>${req.query.title}</h1>`,
    width: 1200,
    height: 630,
    format: "png",
  });
  res.type("image/png").send(Buffer.from(result.data));
});
```

---

## Options Reference (`RenderOptions`)

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `string \| string[] \| Uint8Array \| ArrayBuffer` | - | HTML string, array of HTML strings (multi-page PDF), or raw image bytes (`Buffer` works as `Uint8Array`) |
| `url` | `string` | - | Remote URL to fetch and render (alternative to `value`) |
| `width` | `number` | `800` | Target viewport / output width in pixels |
| `height` | `number` | auto / content | Target viewport / output height in pixels |
| `format` | `string` | `"png"` | Output format: `"png"`, `"jpeg"`, `"webp"`, `"avif"`, `"jxl"`, `"svg"`, `"pdf"`, `"raw"`, `"thumbhash"`, `"none"` |
| `quality` | `number` | `85` | Compression quality (0-100) for JPEG, WebP, and AVIF |
| `speed` | `number` | `6` | CPU effort/speed (0=best quality/slowest, 10=fastest) for AVIF |
| `scale` | `number` | `1.0` | Device pixel ratio / render scaling factor |
| `crop` | `{ x, y, width, height }` | - | Rectangular cropping coordinates |
| `fallbackFonts` | `(Uint8Array \| Buffer)[]` | - | Inlined custom font binaries for air-gapped / offline rendering |
| `fonts` | `Record<string, Uint8Array \| Buffer>` | - | Font family mapping dictionary |
| `timeout` | `number` | `10000` | Timeout in milliseconds for resource loading |

Additional extension keys exist (e.g. `baseUrl`, `fit`, `animation`); see the type definitions for the full list.

---

## Supported HTML & CSS Capabilities (Styling Reference for AI)

The rendering engine couples **litehtml** (HTML/CSS layout) and **Google Skia** (2D graphics engine). It supports a rich subset of modern CSS and HTML without a browser:

### 1. Layout & Box Model
- **Display Modes**: `block`, `inline`, `inline-block`, `flex`, `inline-flex`, `grid`, `inline-grid`, `table`, `table-row`, `table-cell`, `none`.
- **Flexbox**:
  - Container: `display: flex | inline-flex`, `flex-direction` (`row`, `column`, `row-reverse`, `column-reverse`), `flex-wrap` (`nowrap`, `wrap`, `wrap-reverse`), `flex-flow`, `justify-content` (`flex-start`, `flex-end`, `center`, `space-between`, `space-around`, `space-evenly`), `align-items` (`stretch`, `flex-start`, `flex-end`, `center`, `baseline`), `align-content`, `gap`, `row-gap`, `column-gap`.
  - Items: `flex`, `flex-grow`, `flex-shrink`, `flex-basis`, `align-self`, `order`.
- **Grid Layout**:
  - Container: `display: grid | inline-grid`, `grid-template-columns`, `grid-template-rows`, `gap`, `row-gap`, `column-gap`, `place-items`, `place-content`, `justify-items`, `align-items`.
  - Items: `grid-column`, `grid-row`, `grid-column-start`, `grid-column-end`, `grid-row-start`, `grid-row-end`, `place-self`, `justify-self`, `align-self`.
- **Positioning**: `position: static | relative | absolute | fixed`, `top`, `right`, `bottom`, `left`, `inset`, `z-index`.
- **Box Dimensions & Margins**: `width`, `height`, `min-width`, `min-height`, `max-width`, `max-height`, `aspect-ratio`, `box-sizing` (`border-box`, `content-box`), `margin`, `padding`.
- **Logical Properties**: `margin-inline`, `margin-block`, `padding-inline`, `padding-block`, `inset-inline`, `inset-block`, `border-inline`, `border-block`.
- **Floats & Clear**: `float: left | right | none`, `clear: left | right | both | none`.

### 2. Typography & Text Shaping
- **Fonts**: `font-family`, `font-size`, `font-weight` (100–900, `bold`, `normal`), `font-style` (`italic`, `normal`), `font-variant`, `line-height`, `letter-spacing`, `word-spacing`.
- **Text Alignment & Flow**: `text-align` (`left`, `right`, `center`, `justify`), `vertical-align`, `text-transform` (`uppercase`, `lowercase`, `capitalize`, `none`).
- **Wrapping & Breaking**: `white-space` (`normal`, `nowrap`, `pre`, `pre-wrap`, `pre-line`), `text-wrap` (`wrap`, `nowrap`, `balance`), `word-break` (`normal`, `break-all`, `keep-all`), `overflow-wrap` (`normal`, `break-word`, `anywhere`).
- **Ellipsis & Multi-line Clamping**:
  - Single-line: `overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;`
  - Multi-line clamp: `-webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; display: -webkit-box; overflow: hidden;` (also supports standard `line-clamp`).
- **Text Stroke & Shadow**:
  - Stroke: `-webkit-text-stroke: <width> <color>` (also `-webkit-text-stroke-width`, `-webkit-text-stroke-color`, `-webkit-text-fill-color`).
  - Text Shadow: `text-shadow: offset-x offset-y blur-radius color` (multiple comma-separated shadows supported).
  - Text Decoration: `text-decoration` (`underline`, `line-through`, `none`, style, color, thickness, `text-underline-offset`).
  - Text Emphasis: `text-emphasis` (`style`, `color`, `position`).
- **Vertical Writing & Advanced Internationalization**:
  - `writing-mode`: `horizontal-tb`, `vertical-rl`, `vertical-lr`.
  - `text-orientation`: `mixed`, `upright`, `sideways`.
  - `text-combine-upright`: `all`, `digits <2-4>`.
  - HarfBuzz text shaping & BiDi engine: native ligatures, complex scripts (Arabic, Hebrew, Devanagari), CJK ideographs, and colored Emoji.

### 3. Visual Styling & Skia Graphics
- **Colors**: Hex (`#RRGGBB`, `#RRGGBBAA`), `rgb()`, `rgba()`, `hsl()`, `hsla()`, `transparent`, `currentColor`, `opacity` (0.0 to 1.0).
- **Backgrounds**:
  - `background-color`, `background-image` (supports URLs and gradients: `linear-gradient(...)`, `radial-gradient(...)`, `conic-gradient(...)`).
  - `background-repeat`, `background-position`, `background-size` (`cover`, `contain`, lengths, percentages), `background-origin`, `background-clip` (including `-webkit-background-clip: text`).
  - `mix-blend-mode`, `background-blend-mode`, `isolation`.
- **Borders & Corners**:
  - `border`, `border-width`, `border-style` (`solid`, `dashed`, `dotted`, `double`, etc.), `border-color`.
  - `border-radius`: all four corners independently (`border-top-left-radius`, etc.), elliptical radii (`Xpx / Ypx`), logical corner properties (`border-start-start-radius`, etc.).
  - `border-image`: `source`, `slice`, `width`, `outset`, `repeat`.
  - `outline`, `outline-offset`, `outline-width`, `outline-style`, `outline-color`.
- **Box Shadows**: `box-shadow: [inset] offset-x offset-y blur spread color` (supports multiple comma-separated shadows).
- **Clipping**: `clip-path: circle(...) | ellipse(...) | polygon(...) | path("...") | inset(...)`.
- **Transforms**: `transform: translate(...) rotate(...) scale(...) matrix(...)`, `translate`, `rotate`, `scale`, `transform-origin`.
- **Filters**:
  - `filter`: `blur(...)`, `drop-shadow(...)`.
  - `backdrop-filter`: `blur(...)`, `brightness(...)`, `contrast(...)`, `grayscale(...)`, `sepia(...)`, `saturate(...)`, `hue-rotate(...)`, `invert(...)`, `opacity(...)`.
- **Media Object Sizing**: `object-fit` (`fill`, `contain`, `cover`, `none`, `scale-down`), `object-position`.

### 4. Modern CSS Features, Selectors & At-Rules
- **Math & Custom Properties**: `calc(...)`, CSS Variables (`var(--name)`), `light-dark(...)`.
- **Selectors**:
  - Universal (`*`), type (`div`), class (`.card`), ID (`#main`).
  - Attribute selectors (`[attr]`, `[attr="value"]`, `[attr^="prefix"]`, `[attr$="suffix"]`, `[attr*="sub"]`).
  - Combinators: descendant (`A B`), child (`A > B`), adjacent sibling (`A + B`), general sibling (`A ~ B`).
  - Pseudo-classes: `:first-child`, `:last-child`, `:only-child`, `:first-of-type`, `:last-of-type`, `:only-of-type`, `:nth-child(...)`, `:nth-last-child(...)`, `:nth-of-type(...)`, `:nth-last-of-type(...)`, `:not(...)`, `:is(...)`, `:where(...)`, `:has(...)`.
  - Pseudo-elements: `::before`, `::after` with `content: "..."`.
- **At-Rules**:
  - `@media`: `@media screen`, `@media print`, media queries with `min-width`, `max-width`, etc.
  - `@container`: Container queries (`@container (min-width: ...)` with `container-type: inline-size | size`).
  - `@layer`: Cascade layers.
  - `@font-face`: Custom font loading rules.

### 5. Inline SVG Support
- Direct inline `<svg>` rendering powered by **SkSVGDOM**.
- Supported SVG tags: `<svg>`, `<g>`, `<path>`, `<rect>`, `<circle>`, `<ellipse>`, `<line>`, `<polyline>`, `<polygon>`, `<text>`, `<image>`, `<defs>`, `<linearGradient>`, `<radialGradient>`.
- Supported SVG attributes: `fill`, `stroke`, `stroke-width`, `stroke-linecap`, `stroke-linejoin`, `viewBox`, `transform`, `d`, etc.
- Seamlessly mix HTML text with inline SVG icons inside flex/grid containers.

---

## AI HTML/CSS Generation Guidelines (Best Practices)

When prompting an AI agent to generate HTML/CSS templates for `wasm-html-to-image`:

1. **Explicit Root Dimensions**: Always wrap the template in a root container with fixed pixel dimensions and `box-sizing: border-box;` (e.g. `width: 1200px; height: 630px;` for OGP).
2. **Prioritize Flexbox or Grid**: Flexbox (`display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between;`) provides the most reliable and predictable visual layout.
3. **Use Standard Google Fonts**: Simply set `font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;` or `'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;`. The library fetches and caches WOFF2 fonts automatically. For air-gapped or edge runtime execution, pass font buffers to `fallbackFonts`.
4. **Use Inline SVGs for Icons**: Embed `<svg>` tags directly into HTML instead of using external icon fonts or canvas scripts.
5. **Clean Text Truncation**: Use `-webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; display: -webkit-box; overflow: hidden;` for multi-line titles.
6. **Images**: Remote `<img src="https://...">` works when network access is enabled. For offline, edge-isolated, or instant rendering, embed base64 Data URLs (`data:image/png;base64,...`).
7. **Tailwind / UnoCSS Support**: When using utility classes, you can pre-compile them to inline CSS using `wasm-html-to-image/tailwind` (`createCSS()`).

---

## Limitations & Unsupported Features (Do NOT Use)

1. **NO JavaScript Execution**: `<script>` tags, DOM events (`onclick`, `onload`), and DOM manipulations do NOT run. Always generate fully static HTML markup.
2. **NO CSS Keyframe Animations or Transitions**: `@keyframes`, `animation`, and `transition` are not animated. The engine renders static snapshots.
3. **NO HTML5 Canvas Scripting**: `<canvas>` with `canvas.getContext('2d')` does not execute JavaScript. Use `<svg>` or CSS shapes instead.
4. **NO Interactive State Styling**: Dynamic states like `:hover`, `:active`, and `:focus` do not trigger.
5. **NO Browser Web Storage**: `window`, `document`, `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, and `IndexedDB` are unavailable.

---

## Critical Rules for AI Agents (Anti-Patterns to AVOID)

1. **NEVER use Puppeteer, Playwright, or Chromium with this package**: `wasm-html-to-image` compiles litehtml and Skia directly to WebAssembly. It operates entirely in-memory without browser processes.
2. **DO NOT install `@napi-rs/canvas` or `node-canvas`**: Canvas rendering is built directly into the unified WASM engine.
3. **DO NOT pass Base64 data back and forth unnecessarily**: Pass raw `Uint8Array` or `Buffer` directly to `render()`.
4. **Cloudflare Workers preference**: Import from `wasm-html-to-image` (recommended; auto-selects the workerd build on Cloudflare, explicit `wasm-html-to-image/workerd` also works) (no wrangler rules needed on current Wrangler; only needed if you customize bundling rules or use very old Wrangler).
5. **Google Fonts resolution**: Google Fonts are downloaded automatically in WOFF2 format by default. You do NOT need manual font download logic unless working offline.
